What moved: The current economy registers at 3.91 for the year 2025, operating with an actual compound annual growth rate of 8.36 percent over the 2020–2025 period, alongside a mission score of 54 out of 100.

Why it matters: Reaching the 47 trillion dollar goal by 2047 requires an acceleration from the current trajectory, as the required compound annual growth rate stands at 11.97 percent, placing the estimated arrival year at 2056 with a status of behind.

Top priorities: The three mandatory strategic focus areas are Formally skilled workforce, Electronics production, and States with 1T GSDP.
